description: A benchmark dataset for agent-based Uncertainty-aware Building Energy Modelling automation is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Jun Xiao. This dataset is targeted to the Agent-assisted Large-ensemble Building Energy Simulation automation. The processing follows a typical archetype-based Urban Building Energy Modelling workflows, which is described in the tasks-mission.md. This workflow will be processed 10 times with different input files, weathers, and preposed simulation outputs. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4775972 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
